stem.text: When compound X is heated under reflux with aqueous sodium hydroxide solution two products are formed: sodium ethanoate and hexan-1-ol.

A.alt: Skeletal formula of an ethyl ester: a straight carbon chain ending in a C=O group, with the carbonyl O bonded to an O-ethyl group (option A).

B.alt: Skeletal formula of an acetate ester: CH3C(=O)O- bonded to a straight carbon chain (option B).

C.alt: Skeletal formula of an ethyl ester: a straight carbon chain ending in a C=O group, with the carbonyl O bonded to an O-ethyl group (option C).

D.alt: Skeletal formula of an acetate ester: CH3C(=O)O- bonded to a straight carbon chain (option D).
